short: Re-cut the Otto bootstrap from self-contained synthesized kit to one-page framing+pointers boarding pass (canon/bootstrap/otto-boarding-pass).
long: Ruling: the pass is framing and a pointer; the contract is the law. Reasoning: the OTTOBOOTSTRAPKIT's 'self-contained, do not mix' paraphrase let seats fly on the kit instead of fetching canon — the singing stopped. Axiom served: Reality Is Sovereign / fetch-live governance over memory of it. Alternative rejected: patching the kit in place — any synthesized snapshot re-drifts; only pointers stay current.
